<function name="AskToConnect" parent="permissions" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Requests the player to connect to a specified server. The player will be prompted with a confirmation window.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="address" type="string">The address to ask to connect to. If a port is not given, the default `:27015` port will be added.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
